description: Fork of exp206 (val_bpb=1.781 @ 6400 when stopped). Single change: smooth_mode False -> True. With smooth=True the LUT forward uses the soft (rational) anchor projection; gradients flow through near-miss buckets. Same architecture: two LUTs per block (out_proj + ffn), Q/K/V split with separate LNs, per-layer pos. nap=6, tph=1536, n_sparse=32, n_alt=1.
